requirements: Reconcile actual execution of the old be781470 gate, then independently verify the live PR and fork still match this exact head. The removed mocked Python suite and its workflow are intentionally out of scope; do not reinstate or require them.
Run ./gradlew tidy, require no tracked changes, git diff --check, and ./gradlew check -x test. A formatting-modified head requires a new push and gate.

Build full, slim and source release artifacts at this head with ./gradlew -p solr/distribution assembleRelease -Dversion.release=11.0.0-SNAPSHOT, generate Changes.html as needed by the local release workflow, then run the full local smokeTestRelease.py with --not-signed --revision skip and matching version. Capture archive hashes and real full example, slim standalone index/query/stop, source and Maven results; identify skipped legs.

Using the built slim archive, exercise the slim smoke path with inherited SOLR_HOME, SOLR_DATA_HOME, SOLR_INCLUDE, SOLR_JAVA_HOME, SOLR_CONNECTION, ZK_HOST, STOP_PORT and JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS set to isolated sentinel fixtures. Verify core and data stay in the extracted distribution, external sentinels stay unchanged, no external ZooKeeper is contacted, and cleanup stops only the owned process. Include a safely bound dummy stop-port collision to verify retry; do not affect any unrelated process.

Run actual full and slim Docker testDocker on the new head. Run the packaging rolling-upgrade BATS test with the normal previous-major slim start and the current image as end. Also run with a real locally built example-free slim start image without publishing images externally; if unconditional docker pull prevents a local tag, use an isolated temporary harness copy or a wrapper that bypasses pull only for that exact inspected local tag and delegates all other commands. Document overlay and image IDs; require the indexed document to survive the upgrade. Docker/image access failures are incomplete, not passes. Remove only gate-owned resources.

The prior exact-head dc720a2 receipt records real parent fail-before controls and is historical evidence only, not a pass for this head. If feasible independently rerun the parent root-list failure and films failure on the new same-head slim artifact, and clearly report what was run.

Publish an exact-head receipt with each command, exit code, artifact and log hashes, source/fork/PR readback, resource cleanup and actual execution limits. Linux success does not prove the native Cygwin launcher path; report Cygwin separately as unverified unless separately run on a capable host.
